newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt August passenger traffic up 0.8pct.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt August passenger traffic up 0.8pct.

text.p: Passenger business at Frankfurt Airport remained weak in August with a 0.8 percent rise to 3.8 million air travellers, the market research department of airport authority FAG said in its monthly report.
Passenger numbers at Germany's gateway airport have risen 1.9 percent to 25.69 million January-August, the report added.
The slow growth is due to poor domestic economic conditions, unexpectedly weak traffic to holiday destinations and a fall in domestic volumes.
"Traffic to southern and south-eastern Europe as well as to North Africa and North America is stagnating," the FAG report said.

The average passenger seat load factor fell to 106.3 passengers per aircraft movement in August compared to 111 passengers 12 months previously, it added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
